title: Synergy Team Site

modules.title: Getting Started
modules.summary: Log in, find your way around the Team Site homepage and Universal Search, and set up default filters, video settings and favorites.
learning_objectives: Learners will be able to log in to Team Site, including completing two-factor authentication on a new device.
Learners will be able to use Universal Search to find teams and players.
Learners will be able to describe the tools in the Main Menu and User Menu.
Learners will be able to set default filters and video playback preferences in Settings.
modules.content:
Welcome to Team Site! We are pleased to bring you a variety of features, functions, and tools to help guide your work with games, players, and teams. Explore the information below to get started with Team Site!

## Logging In

Navigate to Team Site using the following URL: [https://apps.synergysports.com/basketball.](https://apps.synergysports.com/basketball) When prompted, enter your Synergy login credentials.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-01.jpg)

If you are logging in from a new device or from a new location, you may be asked to complete two-factor authentication. You will need to retrieve the security code from the email address associated with your Synergy account.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-02.jpg)

## Homepage

Once you have logged in, you will be redirected to the **Games** page. From here, you can access all of the tabs, filters, and navigation tools in Team Site.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-03.jpg)

##

## Universal Search

Use the Universal Search to find Teams and Players quickly.  A minimum of three characters are required to yield any search results. The top 10 results for Teams and Players will display on the search. Select a Team or Player to navigate to that team or player page.

> Note: Teams will only show the latest season. Users can then select previous seasons on the Team page. Typing a**/** will open the search box regardless of where you are on the page.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-04.jpg)

Selecting **Load More Teams** or **Load More Players** from the Universal Search will open a separate search results page with up to 500 results.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-05.jpg)

Filters and Search Within Results:

- Search within the results to refine your search further
- Filter by League and Season
- Selecting any Player or Team will launch the selected Player or Team's Page.

##

##

##

## Main Menu

The Main Menu includes links to several tools for Team Site.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-06.jpg)

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-07.jpg)

**Team Site Guide:**Click to read Team Site self-help articles, which can help you navigate the site.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-08.jpg)

**Synergy Automated Camera System:**Click here to log in to the Synergy Sports Hub, where you can access the Synergy Automated Camera System.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-09.jpg)**Print**: Click to print the entire screen you are viewing, or select different sections to be printed

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-10.jpg)

**Training**: Click here to schedule a personalized training session or find video guides for Team Site or any other Synergy product.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-11.jpg)**View Unread Release Updates**: Click to read about new updates to Team Site when a red notification dot is present.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-12.jpg)

**User Profile**: Click to access the User menu with a variety of helpful tools.

## User Menu

Locate the User Menu by selecting the **User Profile**in the upper right corner. From here, users have access to several options:

- Settings
- Support Page
- Download Links
- Submit Feedback
- Community
- My Edits
- Logout

###

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-13.jpg)

**Settings**

In **Settings**, you can adjust your default filters. These filters will be applied each time you open a game, team, or player list. They will also appear on the Quick Filters menu, where you can easily switch between saved filters by clicking on them.

When editing or adding a filter, be sure to save your selections by clicking the **Save Changes**button.

![Screenshot: Getting Started](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565433-14.jpg)

#### Filters

- Filter Name
- League
- Season
- Competition
- Division
- Conference
- Team A
- Team B   **This filter only applies to the Game view.*
- Type **This filter only applies to the Game and Team views.*
- Offensive Role **This filter only applies to the Player view.*

####

#### Video Default Settings

These settings affect the properties of all video clips selected on any statistic or playlist on the Team Site.

- Video Playback Option:
  - Send Video Straight to Default: This will apply the selected default video settings you've chosen from the Settings page.
  - Ask Video Preference Every Time: This will open a pop-up asking you to choose where and how you'd like the video to be sent.
- Playback:
  - In Browser Player: This will play all videos using the Synergy In-Browser Player.
  - Editor: This will send the selected video to your Synergy Editor for trimming, tagging, and creating custom edits.
- Max Clips: Set the maximum number of clips that can be sent at one time
- Clips Order: Choose to see the most recent clips first, the oldest clips first, or a random order of clips.
- Video Quality (if applicable): Select standard or high quality.

####

#### Stats Defaults

Aggregated statistics can be displayed as total possessions or as an average of possessions per game played.

#### Favorites

View and manage your favorite teams and players. These will be used when selecting the 'Favorite Teams' or 'Favorite Players' filters on the game, team or player list.

###

###

**Support Page**

You can click**Support Page** to access the Synergy Support Help Center.

**Download Links**

**Download Links**will direct you to the Synergy Coaching Suite Downloads (Basketball) article. There are links in this article to help you get started with all of the applications associated with this suite:

- Synergy Team Site
- Synergy Editor / MAX Editor
- Synergy Video Express
- Synergy Mobile App
- Synergy Basketball App

###

**Submit Feedback**

Click **Submit** **Feedback** to access the Synergy Basketball Feature Request thread. Provide input, ideas, or feedback on the redesigned Team Site directly to our development team.

###

**Community**

Click **Community** to access the Community page in the Synergy Help Center. This is a place to discuss, ask questions, and connect with us here at Synergy, as well as your peers, about all things Synergy Basketball-related.

**My Edits**

###

My Edits will allow you to access your list of existing Custom and Source Edits.

**Logout**

Click **Logout** to log out of Synergy Team Site.

modules.title: Managing Users and Upload Schedules
modules.summary: Manage your team's user accounts as Team Admin and read the Upload Schedule to see the status of each game.
learning_objectives: Learners will be able to add users and make a staff member an administrator.
Learners will be able to reactivate or deactivate accounts and send emails or password resets.
Learners will be able to open a team's Upload Schedule using the Games Filters.
Learners will be able to interpret the status values on the Upload Schedule.
modules.content:
## Managing Users

As the Team Admin, you have access and responsibility to handle your team's Synergy accounts. You can add new users, reactivate or deactivate existing users, add additional administrators, send password resets, and even email from the Users Tab.

###

### Users Tab

Select the **Users** tab to access all of the users for your team's subscription.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-01.jpg)

Once the Users Tab is open, use the menu on the left side to filter users by user status, user type, and name or expiration date.

####

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-02.jpg)

####

####

#### Add Users

To add a new user, select **+Add**.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-03.jpg)

After selecting **+Add** you can create Staff and Player accounts. You can enter the Name, Title, E-Mail, and Phone Number of the new User. If you are adding a Staff member who you wish to have administrator access to your Synergy account, toggle the **Administrator** button to Yes.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-04.jpg)

Once all fields have been filled, select **Add User**, and the account will be created. A welcome email will be automatically generated with instructions for the user on how to set up their password for their Synergy account.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-05.jpg)

#### Reactivating and Deactivating Accounts

To reactivate or deactivate accounts, you will need to select the **Reactivate** or **Deactivate** buttons on each account, individually.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-06.png)

After you select **Reactivate** or **Deactivate**, you will need to confirm your decision.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-07.jpg)

####

####

#### Sending Emails or Password Resets

To send emails or password resets, you must first select the users you wish to manage. You can use the **Select All** button, or select users by marking the checkboxes in the upper right of the user squares.

> **Note**: Checkboxes will appear once you hover over an account.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-08.png)

Once the users have been selected, the **Email users**and**S****end password reset** options will become available.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-09.jpg)

####

#### Updating Administrators

To change a user to an administrator, you will need to click on **Edit Account**.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-10.png)

Then switch the **Administrator** toggle to Yes, and click **Save User**.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565959-11.jpg)

If you experience any issues or difficulties with your user management, please reach out to our Support Team at [support@synergysports.com](mailto:support@synergysports.com) or call 1-800-411-1627.

## Reviewing Upload Schedules

The **Upload Schedule** feature shows the status of uploaded games, and it details which games teams are required to upload. The Upload Schedule also provides information on the competition categories and any additional comments that are associated with the upload.

> **Note:** If you find your Upload Schedule to be inaccurate, you will need to reach out to Support at [support@synergysports.com](mailto:support@synergysports.com) or by phone at 1(800)411-1627.

### Reviewing Upload Schedules

To get started, click on the **Game** tab. Then click on the **Upload Schedule** tab.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565947-01.jpg)

Use the**Games Filters** on the left to narrow down teams, and then select a team from the **Team A** dropdown.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565947-02.jpg)

Once the **Games Filters** have been applied and you have selected a team from the **Team A** dropdown, that team's upload schedule will appear. The upload schedule will have the most recent game listed at the top.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565947-03.jpg)

The Upload Schedule tab includes functionality that provides information on:

- **Game Date**
- **Game**: Includes the names of the teams playing in the game
- **Type**: Whether the game footage will be pulled from TV or requires an upload by a team participating in the game.
- **Status**: *Not Available*, *Complete*, *P1*, *P2*, *Future* (Coming Soon)
  - **N****ot Available**: The game has not been uploaded yet or is a game that is in the future
  - **P1**: The game is in the Phase I Logged stage. This is the first step of the logging process and means Full Game Video is available for download in Video Express.
  - **P2**: The game is in the Phase 2 Logged stage.  This is the second step of the logging process and means all logging and breakdowns have been completed. All videos and stats are available for this game.
  - **Complete**: The game has been fully logged, and all statistics are associated with the video.
  - **Future**(Coming Soon): This means a game slot has not been created for this game as it is likely far in the future.  Once the game date nears, a game slow will be created for the game and can be used for upload.
- **Competition**: The type of game being played.  Typically, this column will detail whether it's an exhibition, regular season, or playoff game.
- **Comments**: This is where comments can be entered that detail context about the video uploaded or if there's an issue with the upload.

As an added feature, clicking on **Complete**in the status column will redirect you to that game's breakdown.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565947-04.gif)

You can also click on a team name in the **Game** column to display that team's upload schedule.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565947-05.jpg)

Next Up - Team Site for Basketball: Player Tab (see the “Players” lesson)

modules.content:
## In-Browser Player

The In-Bowser Player allows you to watch videos and create custom edits without leaving the web. It has been verified to work in all recent versions of Edge, Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.

Opening the In-Browser Player

You will see the option to open the in-browser player if you click on any video link in Team Site.

> Note: Any stat that is **blue** in Team Site will link to video.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-01.gif)

After you click on a video link, make sure the Playback filter is set to **I****n-Browser Player**. Then select **OK**.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-02.jpg)

The In-Browser Player will open with the clips you selected from Team Site at the bottom. Your Custom Edits and Source Edits will be on the right.

> Note: Full Game Video loads all of the clips into the playlist but shows the video for the entire game as opposed to just clipped video.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-03.jpg)

#####

#####

#####

#####

Playback Options

Once the In-Browser Player is open, your video clips will start playing automatically. If you don't want to watch all of the clips in your playlist, you can select the clips you do want to watch and then click the play icon.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-04.jpg)

Use the controls directly under the video to adjust the video playback. Here you will find controls for video speed, video replay, video skipping, volume control, full-screen mode, etc.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-05.jpg)

**Settings**

To update settings for the In-Browser Player, click on the gear icon on the left. Here, you can change the **Playback** format or click **Options** to see more settings.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-06.jpg)

If you select **Options**, you will see additional settings for Hotkeys, Navigation, and General.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-07.jpg)

The Hotkeys tab shows a list of keyboard shortcuts for the In-Browser Player. You can update these shortcuts by clicking on a hotkey and replacing it.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-08.jpg)

The Navigation tab will allow you to update the jump buttons. Select a button from the list to update time increments and change the measurement from "Seconds" to "Frames."

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-09.jpg)

The General tab will allow you to update Text Overlay and Playback Quality settings. ]

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-10.jpg)

Manage Custom Edits & Source Edits

On the right side of the In-Browser Player, there are tabs for your Custom Edits and Source Edits. In the top-right corner are the control buttons for these edits.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-11.jpg)

**Play or View Edits**

To play or view an edit, you will first need to select an edit. The edit row will be highlighted if you have selected an edit.

> Note: Marking the check box for an edit will not allow you to view or play that edit.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-12.jpg)

After you select an edit, then you can click on the play icon or the view icon. The clips from your edit will then be visible in the playlist at the bottom.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-13.jpg)

**Create New Edits**

Use the + icon to create a new Edit.  After you click the + icon, you will have to name your edit and click **Save** before it shows in your edit list.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-14.jpg)

**Add Clips to Custom Edits**

To add clips to a Custom Edit, click the boxes next to the clips you want to move.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-15.jpg)

Then click one of the drag icons, and drag the clips to the Custom Edit you wish to add them to.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-16.jpg)

Drop the clips into the Custom Edit.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-17.jpg)

You should see a pop-up confirming your clips have been added.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-18.jpg)

**Share Custom Edits**

To share Custom Edits, you will first need to select your edits and then click the share icon.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-19.jpg)

After you click the share icon, you will select whether you would like to send these edits through Synergy or through your personal email.

> Note: You can only send clips through Synergy if the recipient has a Synergy account.

![Screenshot: In-Browser Player](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565434-20.jpg)

Next Up - Team Site for Basketball: Live Video (see the “Watching Video” lesson)

## Live Video

### Live Video

Live video allows you to access near-real-time stats and data while the action is happening. To initiate a live stream, log in to the Synergy Team Site, navigate to the Games tab, use the data filters to populate your desired game, and then click on the**Stream To Editor** link to launch.

> NOTE: This feature is available for MAX Editor Users only.

![Screenshot: Live Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565435-01.gif)

Once you have found your desired game, click the **Stream To Editor** link located at the top of the display table column.

In the popup, click the **Open Synergy Editor** button to launch the live stream. This will also open a tagging template at the same time so that you can begin tagging instantly.

Additionally, the ability to see the tagging that is being done live by another user on a different machine using either Local Capture or Live Video Edits is available.

If another team member is using either Local Capture or Live Video Edits, their live tags will be made visible on the timeline by selecting the **Refresh** button each time a new tag is created. The tags can then be filtered by the user from the **Tags** Filter.

This will allow your staff to have one person tagging the game live while another simultaneously has the ability to curate those clips into different custom edits on the spot.

![Screenshot: Live Video](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565435-02.gif)

modules.content:
## Game Tab

### Game Tab

As the default landing space on the Synergy Team Site, the Game tab is one of the most widely used spaces. The Game tab provides access to all of the information concerning games.

![Screenshot: Game Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565945-01.jpg)

Apply the filters on the left to find games by league, season, division, etc. You can also find games by using the favorites you've saved (Favorite Teams and Favorite Players) or viewing Upcoming Opponents. Use the scroll bar to the right to scroll back by date to the exact game you're looking for.

![Screenshot: Game Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565945-02.jpg)

#### Link to Videos

Clicking on any stat in blue will launch videos associated with that stat.

![Screenshot: Game Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565945-03.jpg)

Hover over a game row to display the video playback options. You can select **Full Game** **Video**, **All Clips,** or **All Possessions**.

- Full Game Video Link: Plays the entire game from start to finish less time outs and any missing time resulting from a technical error. Full Game Video may not be available for all users. Please contact your Account Manager if you do not see the Full Game link and are interested in the Full Game video.

- All Clips: All non-full game video on the website that is broken down into individual video clips. This plays every clip associated with the game selected.

- All Possessions: Plays all possessions associated with the game selected

![Screenshot: Game Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565945-04.jpg)

#### Link to Game Stats

Click anywhere on the left side of a game row to go to the Game Stats page (see the “Games” lesson) for that game.

![Screenshot: Game Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565945-05.gif)

Next Up - Team Site for Basketball: Game Stats Page (see the “Games” lesson)

## Game Stats

### Game Stats

After you select a game from the Game Tab (see the “Games” lesson), you will be redirected to the Game Statspage. The Game Stats page dives into statistics of individual games, providing visual representations along with interactive charts and data.

Game Stats Tools

- **Overall Team and Game stats:**Located at the top of the Game Stats view, explore not only the game score but also the overall record for each team at home, away, and for the series for the two selected teams.

- **All clips****| All Possessions | Full Game Video:** Select any one of these options to view the game film in your preferred style.

![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-01.jpg)

AI Summaries

Clicking on the AI insights button will give you an AI summary based on the Game you have selected.

![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-02.jpg)

After your AI summary has been generated, you can click the AI Insights icon at the top of the page to hide or show the AI analysis.

![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-03.jpg)

Views

You can select from the following views on the Game Stats page:

- Extended Box Score
- Play Types
- Play by Play
- Game Breakdown
- Shot Chart
- Lineups.

#####

##### **Extended Box Score**

Select Extended Box Score to view the matchups between the two teams displayed.

![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-04.jpg)

Extended Box Score tools and features include:

- **Box Score Chart**: Clicking any bar on this chart will show you all game videos for the selected stat and team.

-
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-05.gif)

- **Game Flow Chart:**This chart displays the score difference between the two teams. Hovering over a bar displays the details of that possession. Clicking a bar launches the video of that possession. Clicking the team logo/short name within the circle will launch all video clips in the game for the selected team. Clicking a quarter/half label will launch all videos for that period.

-
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-06.gif)

- **Box Score and Extended Box Score Tables:**
  - Team Selector - This allows you to select either team or both to populate the table.
  - Options (gear) icon
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-07.jpg). Click the box to select or de-select any of the available options.
    - Combine Teams: combines players from both teams into a single table
    - Combine Box Scores: combines box score data from both teams into a single table
    - Split Team in Starter/Bench: Starters and Bench players are put into separate tables.  Also displays separate totals for Starters and Bench.

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-08.jpg)**

#####

#####

##### ****Play Types****

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-09.jpg)**

**Play Types tools and features include:**

- ****Play Type Filters:** Filter your view further using the filters available in the Play Type View.
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-10.jpg)**
  - **Game Period -**Select the period(s) to display data for. Multiple periods can be selected at the same time.
  - **Player -**Select a specific player from the drop-down menu to view data for that player only.
  - **Play Type Details -**Use the Show Players toggle to hide or include the player.

- ****Play Types Chart View:****In Chart View, explore clips for both teams - entire game, clips for one team - entire game, or clips for one team - one quarter/half.  Use the Table/Chart icons to switch between the Chart and Table views. The Table view is designed more like a standard table.**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-11.jpg)**

#####

##### **Play by Play**

Filter by Player, Possession Result, and Game Period to display the Play by Play breakdown.  Click on any Play by Play box to watch the video of that possession.

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-12.jpg)**

##### **Game Breakdown**

View a detailed breakdown of the game covering Stats, Shots, Sets, Transitions, and Press Offense.

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-13.jpg)**

Game Breakdown tools and features include:

- ****Game Breakdown Filters:****Use additional filters to redefine the data displayed in each section. **
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-14.jpg)**
  - **Game Period -**The period(s) to display data for. Select a specific period to view data only for that period.
  - **Player -**Select a specific player to view data for only that player.
  - **Game Breakdown Details -**the Show Players toggle will include or hide the player breakdown within each stat.
- ****Game Breakdown Chart View:****In Chart View, explore clips for both teams - entire game, clips for one team - entire game, or clips for one team - one quarter/half.  Use the Table/Chart icons to switch between the Chart and Table views.  The Table view is designed more like a standard table.**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-15.jpg)**

#####

#####

#####

##### **Shot Chart**

The shot chart view gives a visual display of the location of each shot within the game

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-16.jpg)**

Shot Chart tools and features include:

- ****Shot Chart Filters:****Use additional filters to redefine the data displayed in each section.**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-17.jpg)**
  - **Offensive Team -**Select which team's shot chart to view
  - **Player -**Select player(s) to view only their shots within the chart
  - **Possession Results -**Select result(s) to view only these result types in the chart
  - **Game Period -**Select half(s)/quarter(s) to view only shots made within selected periods. When only one half or quarter is selected, a time range is generated to further refine shotsbased on when shots take place within the period**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-18.jpg)**

- ****Shot Chart Display:**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-19.jpg)**
  - Toggle between All possessions or only shots that have been selected on the visual display
  - Toggle between Use colors or one color for color coding in the visual display
  - Toggle between Scattered chart or Grid chart for a more precise location in the visual display
  - Select 'Open In Basketball Desktop to view the shot chart in the Synergy Basketball App
  - Table View Settings (gear icon): Select between Default, all Columns, or Customize to modify the table view by switching the column's visibility and their order in the table

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-20.jpg)**

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-21.jpg)**

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-22.jpg)**

#####

##### **Lineups**

Lineups are available to users with Advanced Analytics permissions.

#####

![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-23.jpg)

**Lineups tools and features include:**

- ****Lineup View Filters****:**Use the filters in this view to refine the data presented in the chart.
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-24.jpg)**
  - **Offense / Defense**
  - **Team Selector: select either team or both to populate the table**
  - **Clips: click any blue number in the table to view clips of the represented statistics**
  - **Customize Table (gear icon): modify the table view by switching the column's visibility and their order in the table
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-25.jpg)**

**
![Screenshot: Game Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565946-26.jpg)**

**Next Up - Team Site for Basketball: Upload Schedule (see the “Managing Users and Upload Schedules” lesson)**

## Player Tab

### Player Tab

The Player tab provides access to player data. From the Player tab, you can access player stats, visuals, and videos.

![Screenshot: Player Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565948-01.jpg)

Click on the Player tab at the top of the page, and apply the filters on the left to narrow down players by team, league, season, division, etc.

####

![Screenshot: Player Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565948-02.jpg)

#### Link to Video

Click any stat in blue to view stats for that player, from their last five games, with video

![Screenshot: Player Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565948-03.gif)

#### Link to Player Stats

Click the player's name to open the Player Stats page (see the “Players” lesson).

![Screenshot: Player Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565948-04.gif)

#### Link to Team Stats

Click the team name to navigate to the Team Stats page (see the “Teams” lesson).

![Screenshot: Player Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565948-05.gif)

Next Up: Team Site for Basketball: Player Stats Page (see the “Players” lesson)

## Player Stats

### Player Stats

After you select a player from the Player Tab (see the “Players” lesson), u will be redirected to the Player Stats page. This is where you find the stat breakdowns for a player.

Season & Competition Filters

The drop-downs at the top of the page allow you to filter data by Season and Competition type.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-01.jpg)

####

Player Comps

If you have the Insights Package (see the “Insights and Advanced Analytics” lesson), you can also see Player Comps. The top-5 Player Comps for a player – within their division or league as well as the top-5 'NBA role models' for the non-NBA leagues.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-02.gif)

####

AI Summaries

Clicking on the AI insights button will give you an AI summary based on the Player, Season, and Competition you have selected.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-03.jpg)

Clicking on the AI Insights icon at the top of the page will allow you to hide or show the AI analysis.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-04.jpg)

Views Overview

The Player Stats page has multiple view options, and each view displays different data about the player. You will find the following views:

- Overall
- Play Types
- Shot Types
- Cumulative Box
- Player Minutes

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-05.jpg)

##### **Tools and Filters**

You can use tools and features to narrow down the specific details you're searching for within each view. A variation of these tools and features can be found on most of the views on the Player tab:

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-06.jpg)

- Offense / Defense: toggle to switch between the player's offensive and defensive stats
- Stat Breakdown: toggle to include stat subtypes or the game log
- Possessions: toggle to update the data to be a per-game average or total values
- Empty Rows: toggle to hide or show empty stat rows
- Defense: select whether to view stats when the defense is in man, zone, or both
- Play Type: select whether to view stats when the play occurs in half court, transition, put backs, or all
- Short Shot Clock: select whether to see stats where the shot clock is less the 4 seconds, greater or equal to 4 seconds, or both
- Table Views(gear icon): modify the table view by switching column visibility and their order in the table
![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-07.gif)

**Advanced Analytics Filters**

If you have Advanced Analytics, you will see additional filters on the left. These will allow you to filter opponents by division/conference and filter on/off lineup combinations.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-08.jpg)

**Link to Video**

**Blue stats will link to corresponding videos. If you click on a blue number (excluding "ranks")**, then a box will appear with Video Playback Parameters. Make sure the **Playback** filter is set to **In-Browser Player**, and then click OK to open clips.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-09.gif)

**Link to Leaderboards**

Ranks (e.g. *%Time Ranks* and *PPP Ranks*) display the player or team ranking within their league on a scale of 0th (lowest) to 100th (highest). Selecting the blue number will launch the Leaderboards with the rank sorted.

> **Note**: The space will be left blank if there is no ranking available. There will be a dash instead of a number ranking if the 10 possession minimum is not met. By clicking the dash, it will launch the Leaderboard.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-10.gif)

#####

##### **Overall View**

The Player Stats page defaults to the Overall view. This view currently provides a look at a player's Overall stats, a Per Game Breakdown, and Possessions & Assists.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-11.jpg)

##### **Play Types**

Clicking the Play Types view will load the Play Type stats tables. These tables cover Play Types, Overall Drive Direction, Per Game Breakdown, P&R Ball Handler, Isolation, and Post Up.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-12.jpg)

##### **Shot Types**

Clicking the Shot Types view will load the Shot Type stats tables. These tables cover Shot Types, Shot Distances, Shot Quality, and Per Game Breakdown.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-13.jpg)

#####

##### **Cumulative Box**

Clicking this view will load the Cumulative Box score stats tables for all players.

> **Note**: You will only have access to the Projected Stats filter if you have purchased the Insights Package (see the “Insights and Advanced Analytics” lesson).

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-14.jpg)

#####

#####

#####

#####

##### **Lineups**

Users with Advanced Analytics permissions can view **Lineups**. Clicking this view will allow you to see 2-, 3-, 4-, or 5-person lineups for the selected player.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-15.jpg)

#####

#####

##### **Player Minutes**

Users with the Player Minutes permissions can view the Player Minutes stats table. Select a game or multiple games to view video of player minutes in flow or as clips.

> **Note**: Play In Flow is only available when a single game is selected.

![Screenshot: Player Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565949-16.jpg)

Next Up - Team Site for Basketball: Player Tracking Data (see the “Players” lesson)

## Player Tracking Data

Synergy's player tracking data is derived from advanced camera technology that tracks player coordinates and basketball coordinates during games. This article will walk you through locating, filtering, and reading player tracking data.

###

### Locating Player Tracking Data

To get to the player tracking data, you must first navigate to a Player Stats Page (see the “Players” lesson) or a Team Stats Page (see the “Teams” lesson). Follow the instructions below to navigate to either of these pages and locate player tracking data.

1.Depending on what type of data you wish to view, you will click on the **Player** tab or the **Team** tab at the top of the Team Site.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-01.jpg)

2.Adjust the filters on the left to narrow down your search, then select a player or team from the results list.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-02.jpg)

**3.**After you've made your selection, you will be taken to the Player Stats Page or the Team Stats Page. The player tracking data is divided into tabs on the right side of the table:

- Summary
- Offense
- Defense
- Shots
- Drives
- Picks
- Isolations
- Posts
- Speed Load
- Rebounds

###

###

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-03.jpg)

Filtering Player Tracking Data

Each player tracking category *(except Speed Load)* will have filters to the left, which can be used to adjust the tracking data.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-04.jpg)

###

### Games Filters

### You will see additional options appear if you select one of the Games filters at the top:

- **Date Range**
- **Last X Games**
- **Game Selector**

###

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-05.jpg)

### **Date Range**

If you click on the Date Range filter, you will need to adjust the date range calendars.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-06.jpg)

**Last X Games**

If you click on the Last X Games filter, you will need to update how many games to include in your data. You can use the dropdown or type in an "X" amount of games and hit Enter.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-07.jpg)

**Game Selector**

If you click on the Game Selector filter, you will need to select which games you wish to include and then hit **OK**.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-08.jpg)

### Reading Player Tracking Data

Most of the player tracking categories have been defined to give you a better understanding of the tracking data. Hovering your mouse over the **information icons** will reveal these definitions.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-09.jpg)

The player tracking data is divided into VisualizationsandTables. Both components will utilize the two **Color Legends**at the top of the page:

- The**LESS**/**MORE**scale highlights where players are ranked based on frequency.
- The**BAD**/**GOOD** scale highlights where players are ranked based on points per chance (PPC).

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-10.jpg)

### Player Tracking Visualizations

Visualizations help summarize the player tracking data at a glance. These illustrations have been provided to complement the data in the player tracking tables.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-11.jpg)

###

### Player Tracking Tables

When viewing the player tracking tables, you will need to utilize the dropdown icons to see all of the data available. Click on the dropdown icons to reveal tables, and breakdowns within those tables.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-12.gif)

Hovering over a stat will tell you how that stat has been defined.

![Screenshot: Player Tracking Data](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565951-13.gif)

Next Up: Team Site for Basketball: Team Tab (see the “Teams” lesson)

modules.content:
## Team Tab

### Team Tab

The Team tab provides access to team data. From the Team tab you can access team stats, visuals, and videos.

![Screenshot: Team Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565950-01.jpg)

Click on the Team tab at the top of the page, and apply the filters on the left to narrow down teams by league, season, division, etc.

![Screenshot: Team Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565950-02.jpg)

#### Link to Video

Clicking the arrow to the left of a team name will display the last five games for the team, including the final score and statistical leaders. Click any score or stat that is blue to pull up relevant video.

![Screenshot: Team Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565950-03.gif)

#### Link to Game Stats

Use the buttons next to team names to view **Home**, **Away**, **Season**games. Clicking one of these buttons will open your selection in the Games tab (see the “Games” lesson). From the Games tab, you can select a specific game to see Game Stats (see the “Games” lesson).

![Screenshot: Team Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565950-04.gif)

You can also use the Game Flow Chart to link to Game Stats. Hover over the Game Flow Chart on the right to quickly scan games, and then click to open the Game Stats (see the “Games” lesson)page for a specific game.

![Screenshot: Team Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565950-05.gif)

####

#### Link to Team Stats

Click on a team name to open the Team Stats page (see the “Teams” lesson).

![Screenshot: Team Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565950-06.gif)

Next Up: Team Site for Basketball: Team Stats Page (see the “Teams” lesson)

## Team Stats

### Team Stats

After you select a team from the Team Tab (see the “Teams” lesson), you will be redirected to the Team Stats page. This is where you find the stat breakdowns for a specific team.

Season & Competition Filters

The drop-downs at the top of the page allow you to filter data by Season and Competition type.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-01.jpg)

AI Summaries

Clicking on the AI insights button will give you an AI summary based on the Team, Season, and Competition you have selected.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-02.jpg)

Clicking on the AI Insights icon at the top of the page will allow you to hide or show the AI analysis.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-03.jpg)

Views Overview

On the Team Stats page, you will find the following views:

- Overall
- Play Types
- Shot Types
- Cumulative Box
- Game Log *(only available to Advanced Analytics users)*

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-04.jpg)

#####

##### **Tools and Filters**

**You can use tools and features to narrow down the specific details you're searching for within each view. A variation of these tools and features can be found on most of the views on the Team tab:**

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-05.jpg)

- Offense / Defense: toggle to switch between the player's offensive and defensive stats
- Stat Breakdown: toggle to include stat subtypes or the game log
- Possessions: toggle to update the data to be a per game average or total values
- Defense: select whether to view stats when the defense is in man, zone, or both
- Play Type: select whether to view stats when the play occurs in half court, transition, put backs, or all
- Short Shot Clock: select whether to see stats where the shot clock is less than 4 seconds, greater or equal to 4 seconds, or both
- Table Views(gear icon): modify the table view by switching column visibility and their order in the table
![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-06.gif)

**Advanced Analytics Filters**

If you have Advanced Analytics, you will see additional filters on the left. These will allow you to filter opponents by division/conference and filter on/off lineup combinations.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-07.jpg)

**Link to Video**

**Blue stats will link to corresponding videos. If you click on a blue number (excluding "ranks")**, then a box will appear with Video Playback Parameters. Make sure the **Playback** filter is set to **In-Browser Player**, and then click OK to open clips.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-08.gif)

**Link to Leaderboards**

Ranks (e.g. *%Time Ranks* and *PPP Ranks*) display the player or team ranking within their league on a scale of 0th (lowest) to 100th (highest). Selecting the blue number will launch the Leaderboards with the rank sorted.

> **Note**: The space will be left blank if there is no ranking available. There will be a dash instead of a number ranking if the 10 possession minimum is not met. By clicking the dash, it will launch the Leaderboard.

####

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-09.gif)

##### **Overall View**

The Team Stats page defaults to the Overall view. This view currently provides a look at a team's Overall stats and Per Game Breakdown.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-10.jpg)

##### **Play Types**

Clicking the Play Types view will load the Play Type stats tables. These tables cover Play Types, Per Game Breakdown, P&R Ball Handler, Isolation, and Post Up.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-11.jpg)

#####

#####

##### **Shot Types**

Clicking the Shot Types view will load the Shot Type stats tables. These tables cover Shot Types, Shot Distances (Jumpers), Shot Quality, and Per Game Breakdown.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-12.jpg)

##### **Cumulative Box**

Clicking this view will load the Cumulative Boxscore stats tables for all players.

> **Note**: You can only access the Projected Stats filter if you have access to the Insights Package (see the “Insights and Advanced Analytics” lesson).

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-13.jpg)

##### **Lineups**

Users with Advanced Analytics permissions can view Lineups. Clicking this view will allow you to see 2-, 3-, 4-, or 5-person lineups for the selected team.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-14.jpg)

##### **Game Log**

The Game Log view includes a table and a flowchart. Click on the Game Log to see all of the game results from the selected season.

> **Note**: You can only see the Game Log table if you have access to Advanced Analytics.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-15.jpg)

**Game Flowchart**

The flowchart on the right displays all the games from the selected season. Hovering over the flowchart will show game results. Clicking on a specific game will redirect you to the Game Stats (see the “Games” lesson) page for that game.

![Screenshot: Team Stats](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565436-16.gif)

Next Up: Team Site for Basketball: Leaderboards Tab (see the “Leaderboards” lesson)

modules.content:
## Leaderboards Tab

Leaderboards deliver rankings of players and teams, based on the situations and stats you select. Leaderboards help you understand how players and teams compare to the rest of the league or competition in certain situations and statistical categories.

## Leaderboard Types

Team Site has multiple Leaderboards that are designed for different users.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-01.jpg)

- **Player Leaderboards** *(available to all users)* -shows player rankings
- **Team Leaderboards** *(available to all users)* - shows team rankings
- **Player Tracking Leaderboards***(available to users with Synergy Cameras) -*shows player rankings based on player tracking data from Synergy Automated Cameras
- **Team Tracking Leaderboards***(available to users with Synergy Cameras) -*shows team rankings based on team tracking data from Synergy Automated Cameras
- **Player Impact Leaderboards** *(available to users with insights package)*- shows player rankings that evaluate the overall impact a player makes when they are on the court.
- **Team Adjusted Leaderboards** **(available to users with insights package) -**shows team rankings that account for several factors:
  - the strength of the opponent
  - the venue (home or away)
  - the number of rest days taken before the game (i.e. travel schedules)
  - the stakes of the moment (was it a high-leverage possession in a tight game or a "garbage time" play?)
  - the stage of the season (e.g., was it the first game of the year?)
- **Player Projection Leaderboards** *(available to users with insights package)*- shows player rankings based on the expected box score contributions that players will make to their team for the rest of the season.

  ###

## Navigating Leaderboards

Hover over the **Leaderboard** **Tab** at the top and choose the Leaderboard you wish to view.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-02.jpg)

Use the **Team/Player Filter**on the left to narrow down teams or players by season, division, competition type, teams, player roles, etc.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-03.jpg)

You can use the **Leaderboard filters**, at the top, to update the parameters of the leaderboard table and to export it.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-04.jpg)

###

### Selecting A Situation

Selecting a Situation allows you to choose the type of situation you'd like to have showcased on the Leaderboard. Click on the**Situation** filter to bring up the **Select a Situation** window.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-05.jpg)

When the **Select a Situation** window appears, you can select a situation. Use the dropdown icons to see more specific situation options.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-06.jpg)

On the Player Tracking Leaderboards and the Team Tracking Leaderboards, you will need to utilize the tabs at the top to see all of the situations available:

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-07.jpg)

On the Player Leaderboards and Team Leaderboards you will have an additional option to link to the Player Tracking Leaderboards.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-08.jpg)

## Modifying Leaderboards

###

### Arrange by Stats

Clicking on a stat on the leaderboard will arrange teams or players based on the stat selected.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-09.gif)

- Note: SSQ, SSM, and PPS stats refer to Synergy Shot Quality (SSQ), Synergy Shot Making (SSM), and Points per Shot (PPS).

###

###

### Customize Leaderboard Tables

The gear icon allows you to customize which stats you would like to appear in the table. To customize a table and save it for future use, click the gear Icon and select **Customize.**

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-10.gif)

In the Column Customization pop-up window, you can create a custom table:

1. Select the**Copy** icon next to the Default view**.** This will create a New View.
2. Select the **Edit** option to rename your table. Hit **Enter** on your keyboard or click the **Check** symbol to save the new name.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-11.gif)

In the middle section, there is an option to **Select All** or **Deselect All** column headings in the top right corner of the window, or you can check or uncheck the column headings manually to suit your visibility preferences.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-12.gif)

To rearrange the column order, you can drag and drop the three stacked lines next to the column name and move them up or down accordingly. Click **Ok** to save.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-13.gif)

###

##

## Exporting Leaderboards

The export feature allows you to export the Leaderboard data via a spreadsheet in two formats, an Excel spreadsheet or a CSV.

![Screenshot: Leaderboards Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565952-14.jpg)

Next Up: Team Site for Basketball: Leaderboards - Transfer Portal (see the “Recruiting: Transfer Portal and Grassroots” lesson)

modules.content:
## Transfer Portal

The transfer portal feature allows users to view the status of NCAA Division I and Division II college men, and NCAA Division I women.

> Note: Transfer data for college men is provided by Verbal Commits. Transfer data for college women is provided by third-party websites.

###

### **Transfer Portal**

First, select the **Transfer Portal**tab.

####

![Screenshot: Transfer Portal](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565953-01.jpg)

Then set the **Team/Player Filter** on the left. Be sure that you are viewing the correct **League** and **Season**.

![Screenshot: Transfer Portal](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565953-02.jpg)

####

#### Transfer Status

The Transfer Status options are All, Intends to Transfer, and Committed.

- All - shows all players in College Men or College Women
- Intends to Transfer - shows players that are intending to transfer (D1 and D2 college men and D1 college women)
- Committed - shows players who have committed from the transfer portal by joining a new team. Those who withdraw from the transfer portal, without switching teams, will just fall back into the 'All' bucket.

####

![Screenshot: Transfer Portal](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565953-03.jpg)

####

####

#### **Leaderboard Filters**

Use the Leaderboard filters at the top to specify the **Report Type**, **Possessions**, **Situations**, and **Min. Possessions** fields.

> Note: If a player had no possessions that season, they will not show. Similarly if players have less than 10 possessions and you do not adjust the **Min. Possessions** filter, those players will not show.

![Screenshot: Transfer Portal](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565953-04.jpg)

- Report Type:
  - Player Offense: Ranks individual player’s offensive stats by Sort By filter
  - Player Defensive: Ranks individual player's defensive stats by Sort By filter
  - Team Offensive: Ranks team's offensive stats by Sort By filter
  - Team Defensive: Ranks team's defensive stats by Sort By filter
- Possessions: Determines if the stats in the generated leaderboard will be displayed as total possessions or as per possession per game values.
- Situations: Determines what type of game situation data is showcased. Situations are covered in more detail further in the article.
- Min Possessions: The minimum possessions needed to be included in the rankings.
  - The default setting is 10 possessions
  - Change by deleting 10 and manually typing in a new number

#### Permissions

The**Transfer Portal Leaderboard**will only show up if your team has Transfer Portal permissions. If you would like to get permissions for your organization, please contact your account manager.

Next Up - Team Site for Basketball: Scouting Report (see the “Scouting and Comparison” lesson)

## Grassroots Tab

### Grassroots Tab

The Grassroots tab provides access to Synergy’s Grassroots circuit data. To find a specific team, click on the Grassroots tab and apply the filters at the top to narrow down selections by event, division, and team.

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-01.jpg)

#### Grassroots Team pages

Selecting a team from the Grassroots tab will take you to a list of the team's players. The team stats will be displayed at the top of the page along with a Game Log in the upper right.

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-02.jpg)

#####

##### Team Stats

Team stats will be listed under the team’s name. Clicking on the team’s name will take you to the Team Stats page for that team.

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-03.gif)

##### Game Log

Hover over the Game Log to see the team's game history. Clicking on a game will take you to the Game Stats page for the game you’ve selected.

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-04.gif)

#####

##### Team Players

Players will be listed with their jersey numbers and other relevant information. Clicking on a player’s name will take you to the Player Stats page for that player.

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-05.gif)

You also have the option to view offensive and defensive video of the players.

####

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-06.gif)

#### NBA Academy page

Selecting NBA Academy from the events filter will take you to the NBA Academy page.

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-07.jpg)

Here you will find a list of NBA Academy players. Clicking on a player’s name will take you to the Player Stats page for that player.

![Screenshot: Grassroots Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565956-08.gif)

## Scouting Report

The Scouting Report grants users with Advanced Analytics access to additional comparison tools.  These tools provide detailed metrics on opponent tendencies.

### Scouting Report

To get started, hover over the **Analytics** tab in the menu bar at the top of the screen, and then select  **Scouting Reports** from the dropdown.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-01.jpg)

Use the filters on the left side of the screen to find the teams that you'd like to use in your scouting report.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-02.jpg)

Click on the two teams that you would like to add to compare in your report. Once both teams are selected, click **Show Scout Report.** Then the scouting report will populate with three tabs:

- Summary
- Heat Check
- Tempo

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-03.gif)

####

#### Summary

The Summarytab includes a recap of stats for both teams, including total games played and their overall home and away records to date. You can also compare a variety of game stats based on **Per Game** or **Total Value**, and **Offense** or **Defense**.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-04.jpg)

Use the pencil edit icon next to the data heading to customize the data displayed in the table.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-05.gif)

Scroll down to the bottom of the screen to use the **Add/remove stats**button to add or remove additional data displayed in the table.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-06.jpg)

#### Heat Check

The Heat Check tab provides you with a visualized graph of the last 10 games for both teams. The graph evaluates key players and tempo, based on the number of possessions and effectiveness.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-07.jpg)

Use the dropdown arrow to select your desired statistic, then choose the player(s) from each team you want to compare. There is also an option to Show Top Players' performance, which shows the top 5 players for that statistic from each team in the right column.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-08.gif)

#### Tempo

On the Tempo tab you will find bar graph comparisons as well as league rankings for each stat. You can click on team names to switch from Offense to Defense stats.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-09.gif)

You can also choose to see data based on totals or possessions per game.

![Screenshot: Scouting Report](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565954-10.gif)

Next Up: Team Site for Basketball: Comparison View (see the “Scouting and Comparison” lesson)

## Comparison View

### Overview

The Comparison functionality, formerly Digital DNA, allows you to compare any player or team across leagues, seasons, or competition types.  Comparison helps you understand how players or teams compare to each other in a selected situation and statistical category. This feature helps you build game plans around teams or players in certain situations.

###

### Comparison View

To get started, click on the **Analytics** Tab at the top of the screen and choose **Comparison**.

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-01.jpg)

Choose your league, season, and competition from the drop-downs, then select a team or player. Once the data from your first choice populates, click **Add Teams To Comparison**or**Add Players To Comparison** to add a player or team to compare it to.

> Note: if you are comparing players, and not teams, you will also see an "offensive role" drop-down.

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-02.jpg)

Next, set your filter options on the top panel to showcase the data sets you'd like to view.  The comparison charts will automatically generate based on the filters you select.

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-03.jpg)

The filters below are available to help you drill further into the data you'd like to view.

- Teams/Players
  - Teams: Compares the selected team(s) stats
  - Player: Compares the selected player(s) stats
- Possessions Grouping:
  - Per Game: Displays the generated stats by game
  - Total: Displays the generated stats by total to date
- Offense/Defense:
  - Offense: Compares the selected teams or players by offensive stats
  - Defense: Compares the selected teams or players by defensive stats
- Show Play Types/Stats
  - Play Types: Compares the selected teams or players by the type of offensive play
  - Stats: Compares the selected teams or players by the statistical data
- Play Type Charts Display
  - PPP: Displays and compares data by points per possession
  - %Time: Displays and compares data by the percent of time utilized

### Play Types

To change a current play type, click on the pencil icon next to the heading name and choose your desired play type. To add additional play types to your chart, click the **Add More Play Types** icon and choose your desired play(s).

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-04.gif)

The play type defaults are: Points Per Possession (PPP), Possessions (POSS), Effective Field Goal Percentage (EFG%), Turnover Percentage (TO%), Free Throw Percentage (FT%), and Points Scored.

You can further customize the play types by selecting any of the play type options in the drop-down.

These play types are:

- Games Played (GP)
- Free Throws Made (FT Made)
- 2PT Field Goals Made (2 FG Made)
- 3PT Field Goals Made (3 FG Made)
- Total Rebounds (TTL REB)
- Offensive Rebounds (OFF REB)
- Defensive Rebounds (DEF REB)
- Assist (AST)
- Turnovers (TO)
- Steals (STL)
- Blocks (BLK)
- Field Goal Attempts (FG ATT)
- Field Goals Made (FG MADE)
- Field Goals Made (FG MISS)
- Field Goals Percent (FG%)
- 2Pt Field Goal Attempts (2FG ATT)
- 2Pt Field Goals Missed (2FG MISS)
- 2Pt Field Goals Percent (2 FG%)
- 3Pt Field Goal Attempts (3FG ATT)
- 3 Pt Field Goals Missed (3 FG MISS)
- 3 Pt Field Goals Percent (3 FG%)
- Free Throw Attempts (FT ATT)
- Free Throws Missed (FT MISS)
- Free Throws Made (FT MADE)
- Assist-to-Turnover Ratio (AST/TO)
- And 1 (+1)
- And 1 Percent (+1%)
- Percent Shooting Foul (%SF)
- Shooting Foul (SF)
- Score Percent (SCORE%)

###

### Comparison Table

Further down the screen, you'll see a customizable comparison table. This table showcases the stats for each team or player that you've opted to compare.

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-05.jpg)

The **Settings** icon (gear icon) allows you to choose which stats will be displayed on the table. To customize a current table view and save it for future use, click the gear icon and select **Customize.**

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-06.gif)

In the Column Customization pop-up window, you can create a custom table view by selecting the **Copy** icon next to the Default view**.** This will create a new view that you can Edit, Copy or Delete. Selecting the **Edit** option will allow you to rename your table (hit **Enter** on your keyboard or click the **Check** symbol to save the new name).

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-07.gif)

In the middle section, there is an option to **Select All** or **Deselect All** column headings in the top right corner of the window, or you can check or uncheck the column headings manually to suit your visibility preferences.

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-08.gif)

To rearrange the column order, you can click, drag and drop the three stacked lines next to the column name and move them up or down accordingly. Click **Ok** to save. You can create as many custom table views as needed.

![Screenshot: Comparison View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565955-09.gif)

## Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)

The Multi Game Shot Chart (MGSC) allows you to track shots and their respective locations on the floor, over the course of an entire season. Use this tool to select specific parameters for what types of shots you want to see.

**Getting Started**

To get started, go to the **Analytics** tab and then select **Multi Game Shot Chart**(MGSC).

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-01.jpg)

Use the filters on the left to narrow down what information you wish to show. Before you can see the MGSC, you must first select a **League**, **Season**, **Competition**, and **Team.**

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-02.jpg)

After you set your filters, the MGSC will appear along with a legend. The legend will update whenever you update the filters.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-03.jpg)

**Adjusting MGSC**

In addition to filters, users can also adjust the **Stat Shown** and **Z****ones** on the Multi Game Shot Charts.

Stat Shown Filter

Choose whether you wish to display field goal percentages or Synergy Shot Quality.

> **Note**: Synergy Shot Quality determines the expected points per shot, based on shot type, shot distance, and other factors.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-04.jpg)

Zones Filter

**Court Zones** and **Hex Zones** illustrate player tendencies in specific areas on the court.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-05.jpg)

Hex Zones additionally show where shots are taken within each zone and at what frequency. Smaller hexagons represent less frequency, and larger hexagons represent more frequency.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-06.jpg)

You have the option of viewing the MGSC divided into 11, 16, or 32 different zones.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-07.jpg)

**Player Data, Shots Data, & Shots Playlists**

Underneath the Multi Game Shot Chart, you will find tabs for **Player Data**, **Shots Data**, and **Shots Playlists**.

Player Data

The Player Data tab shows player stats, based on your filter selections. As you update the MGSC filters, the player stats will also update.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-08.jpg)

Clicking on any stat in blue will launch videos associated with that stat. You can elect to open the video in the In-Browser Player of the Synergy Editor.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-09.jpg)

Shots Data

The Shots Data tab shows a list of shots taken, based on your filter selections. As you update the MGSC filters, the shots data will also update.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-10.jpg)

You can select shots from the Shot Data tab to watch or add to a **Shots Playlist**. You also have the option to watch all of the shot clips.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-11.jpg)

Shots Playlists

To create a Shots Playlist, you will select shots from the Shots Data tab, and then click **Add to****playlist**.Or you can add shots to the playlist by clicking the **+** buttons.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-12.jpg)

Use the trashcan icons on the Shots Data tab or the Shot Playlist tab to remove shots from the playlist.

![Screenshot: Multi-Game Shot Charts (MGSC)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000581852-13.jpg)

## Practice Tab

The Practice Tab is a special feature for those who have access to Synergy Editor Max as well as Synergy Team Site. On Editor Max, users have the option to tag their practices/scrimmages and then publish that data to Team Site. That data will then appear in a box score view on the Practice Tab.

To learn more about publishing tagged practice data on Editor Max, you can review the following article: Setting up Practice Tagging (see the “Practice Tagging and Analysis” lesson in Synergy Editor).

###

### Practice Tab

After your practice has been published on Editor Max, select the Practice Tab on Team Site to view the data.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-01.jpg)

Select the dropdown button next to the name of your practice to view a player breakdown.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-02.jpg)

#### Video

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-03.gif)

####

#### Segment

####

The Segment dropdown will allow you to select different drills that were used in practice. The segments that you see will be based on the segments that were created in the Editor.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-04.jpg)

####

####

#### Players

The **Player** dropdown will allow you to select a specific player. By selecting a player, you will be able to see their individual practice stats.

####

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-05.jpg)

#### Table Views

The gear icon allows users to customize the stats that are shown on the table.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-06.jpg)

After clicking the gear icon, the Table Views menu will pop up.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-07.jpg)

Click the copy icon to create a new table view.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-08.gif)

Click the edit icon to rename the table view. Then press enter to save the new name.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-09.gif)

Select what you would like shown on your table by selecting and deselecting the stats listed. Then click the **Ok** button to save.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-10.gif)

You will now be able to select your new table view from the Table View icon.

![Screenshot: Practice Tab](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565957-11.jpg)
